# Code of conduct

## Our commitment

We are committed to making participation in RoBeats Calculator Engine a respectful, harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of background, identity, experience level, or ability.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful, constructive, and specific.
- Assume good intent while addressing technical disagreements with evidence.
- Keep feedback focused on the work, not the person.
- Welcome questions and help contributors learn the project's conventions.
- Respect privacy and do not share another person's private information.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, threats, discrimination, or personal attacks
- Sexualized language or unwanted attention
- Trolling, sustained disruption, or deliberately inflammatory comments
- Publishing private information without explicit permission
- Any conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional community

## Scope

This code applies in repository issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews, and other spaces where someone is representing the project.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to the repository owner through their [GitHub profile](https://github.com/TheBaconactor). Do not use a public issue to report sensitive conduct concerns.

Project maintainers may edit or remove contributions that violate this code and may temporarily or permanently restrict participation. Reports will be reviewed as promptly and confidentially as practical, with action based on context and severity.
